project: Hypothetical example: work-order bootstrap in one staging environment
assumptions: TEACHING EXAMPLE, HYPOTHETICAL AND NOT EXECUTED. All contracts are draft; all tasks are todo; PRs are planned; observed_evidence is empty. No access, resource, PR, merge, apply or test is declared done.

Slice: first internal staging of a work-order application with API, web, login through an existing IdP, operator and technician roles, open/list/update/complete and synthetic attachments. The demonstration uses only test data.

Complete inventory only for the directly managed objects and the declared external dependencies of this slice. It is not a complete inventory of the AWS account. ENIs, transient tasks, backups and other objects managed internally by the services are derived effects, not independent resources of this list.

Out of the slice: production, HA, multi-region, tenant onboarding, payments, email/SMS, creation of directory/users, malware pipeline for real files, Kubernetes, new domain/ALB/VPC, landing zone, new runner and migration of an existing database. Including any item requires revising scope, resources, risks and estimates.

Illustrative target AWS + Terraform + GitHub Actions. Replace example/orders-service with the real authorized repository. The repository is assumed to already exist, with an existing merge policy; creating the repository is not a hidden step.

One staging, one service replica and one Single-AZ RDS instance are lab assumptions. Quantities are per environment; external_*_bundle rows represent an identified external capability, not a count of its physical objects. Do not add software capabilities to billable resources as if they were the same unit.

Network, HTTPS ingress, cluster, state backend, IdP/client, private runner, OIDC provider and bootstrap identity are assumptions for DISCOVERY to verify. If they fail, block the dependent actions and revise the plan; do not fill observed_evidence with suppositions.

The first apply uses existing identity and backend; only afterwards does the new OIDC role enable delivery. This order avoids depending on the very role/pipeline that is yet to be created. Do not disable controls to solve bootstrap.

Four real workers are modeled: worker-api, worker-web, worker-platform and worker-delivery-qa. The global limit is four, and each owner runs only one task at a time. CI and QA share capacity; there are no five implicit workers.

Review capacity is shared through the reviewer:shared lock and consumes one of the same workers. API, web, platform and delivery authors review areas of another owner; the scenarios written by the main APP reviewer have a separate review in QA-REVIEW.

Foundation and runtime use separate roots, directories and state keys in the same backend. Each apply acquires the real lock of its state. The base can be applied/verified without waiting for API or web; runtime can only be applied with a verified digest and schema.

The four PRs represent grouped capabilities, not one PR per resource. PR-01 includes several resources; PR-02 brings together the flow and its tests/migration; PR-03 enables delivery; PR-04 integrates runtime. Authoring, review, merge, apply and proof of the result appear separately when they change readiness.

Each minute range is a teaching guess, not a measurement or commitment. likely is used by plan.py; optimistic/conservative are scenarios, not statistical intervals. They include continuous work, but not unpredictable external queues, missing access, incidents, rejections or rework.

The conditional forecast assumes a satisfactory discovery, authorized access/budget and real completion of CONTRACT-REVIEW. contract_gates allow simulating the scenario without changing draft/todo, granting authorization or making tasks dispatchable in the real snapshot.
Price, region, sizing, retention, IDs, ARNs, OIDC subjects, runners and repository paths must be verified at execution. No fictitious price or identifier is evidence of availability.

The administrative secret managed by RDS stays restricted to bootstrap. APP-SECRET is only metadata in the foundation; SCHEMA-APPLY creates the restricted user and the initial version of the secret, before RUNTIME-APPLY. The value does not enter the state or the evidence.

API and web make up a single artifact to limit the infrastructure. REPOSITORY and RELEASE-IMAGE are configuration/artifact scopes; their quantity must not be read as the cost of a new account or of another environment.

API, web and QA work in independent worktrees. APP-ASSEMBLE brings the commits together in one branch and tests the set locally before APP-REVIEW; this consolidation belongs to the same PR-02 and does not replace E2E in staging.

BASE-PLAN produces a real plan before BASE-REVIEW and BASE-MERGE. The later apply confirms that the integrated content, inputs and state match the reviewed plan; material differences require reconciliation and updated evidence, without redundant approval of unchanged content.

resources.name: Target GitHub repository already created
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: example/orders-service is a fictitious identifier; replace it with the existing authorized repo. Creating a repo is not in this slice.
expected_evidence: Real URL, owner, default branch and checks observed; no URL is declared to exist in this example

resources.name: VPC approved for staging
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: The network is administered outside this scope and its ID must be confirmed.
expected_evidence: Account, region, VPC ID and owner observed

resources.name: Private subnets in two AZs
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: Two subnets already exist; no subnets or routes are created in this plan.
expected_evidence: Two IDs and distinct AZs, routes, DNS and address range verified

resources.name: Egress contract and routes already managed
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: An external bundle provides reach to ECR, logs, secrets and IdP; specific NAT/endpoints must be inventoried by discovery, outside the creation scope of this slice.
expected_evidence: Network paths and attributed costs; proof of reach to the required services

resources.name: Existing HTTPS ingress: ALB, listener, certificate and DNS
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: Reuse an externally administered HTTPS capability; confirm the four components and a free route. Do not create a new ALB, certificate or domain.
expected_evidence: ALB/listener ARNs, valid certificate, observed DNS and an available listener rule priority

resources.name: Existing ECS cluster
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: A Fargate-compatible cluster exists; its capacity and region must be confirmed.
expected_evidence: Cluster ARN, region and capacity configuration observed

resources.name: Existing Terraform backend with locking
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: The backend and its encryption/locking are administered outside the slice; use two state keys, foundation and runtime.
expected_evidence: Backend location and configuration, two isolated keys, a safe access test and the lock mechanism confirmed

resources.name: Authorized identity for the first bootstrap
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: An existing identity applies the foundation before the CI role is created. If absent, stop the applies and revise the plan.
expected_evidence: Assumed identity, authorization scope, account, region and budget confirmed

resources.name: GitHub IAM OIDC provider already registered
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: The provider exists in the account; verify the issuer, the audience and the real subject format of the repository.
expected_evidence: ARN and trust configuration observed; subject format confirmed without exposing a token

resources.name: Private runner authorized for plan and migration
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: An isolated runner already reaches AWS services and the DB private network. Its provisioning is outside the slice.
expected_evidence: Runner, isolation, backend access and network path to the DB demonstrable

resources.name: IdP and client registration of the staging application
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: Issuer, audience, web client and callbacks are already approved; directory creation or user registration does not belong to the slice.
expected_evidence: Issuer/audience, callbacks and synthetic users authorized for the two roles observed

resources.name: Existing operational destination for staging alerts
resources.justification: ASSUMPTION TO VERIFY: A notification route already has an owner; do not register recipients or send unauthorized messages.
expected_evidence: Destination ARN/configuration and owner confirmed; distinguish notification configuration from a send test

resources.name: Application ECR repository
resources.justification: Receive images identified by digest before activating the runtime.
expected_evidence: ARN, access policy, retention and publishing target verified

resources.name: OIDC role for staging delivery
resources.justification: Allow CI to use a short-lived identity after bootstrap.
expected_evidence: ARN and trust policy restricted to the real repo/environment

resources.name: Inline policy of the delivery role
resources.justification: Restrict publish, deploy and access actions to the planned resources/states.
expected_evidence: Effective document and positive/negative scope checks

resources.name: ECS task execution role
resources.justification: Allow the runtime to pull the image, read the application secret and send logs.
expected_evidence: ARN and ECS trust principal verified

resources.name: ECS execution inline policy
resources.justification: Grant access only to the required artifacts, logs and application secret.
expected_evidence: Restricted policy; the runtime does not receive the DB administrative secret

resources.name: Application role for attachments
resources.justification: Separate the process identity from the execution identity.
expected_evidence: ARN and ECS trust verified

resources.name: Inline policy for attachment access
resources.justification: Restrict application operations to the planned bucket/prefixes and actions.
expected_evidence: Effective policy and absence of generic access to buckets or secrets

resources.name: Private bucket for synthetic attachments
resources.justification: Store the attachments of the test slice.
expected_evidence: Observed name/ARN and ownership configured

resources.name: Bucket public access block
resources.justification: Prevent accidental public access.
expected_evidence: Four public access blocks enabled

resources.name: Bucket encryption configuration
resources.justification: Define explicit default encryption.
expected_evidence: SSE configuration chosen and observed; no new implicit key in this slice

resources.name: Bucket TLS policy
resources.justification: Require secure transport without granting public read.
expected_evidence: Transport policy and private access validated

resources.name: Restricted CORS for browser attachments
resources.justification: Allow only the origin, methods and headers required by signed upload.
expected_evidence: Exact staging origin, minimal methods and no improper wildcard

resources.name: Retention of synthetic staging attachments
resources.justification: Apply the approved retention only to the fixtures prefix; do not include real data.
expected_evidence: Rule and test prefix reviewed; duration is a scope input

resources.name: Service security group
resources.justification: Allow traffic from the ingress source and the required egress.
expected_evidence: Effective rules and authorized source identified

resources.name: DB security group
resources.justification: Allow PostgreSQL only from the runtime and from the network identity of the migration runner.
expected_evidence: Source/port of the rules and absence of public access

resources.name: RDS subnet group
resources.justification: Associate RDS with the existing private network.
expected_evidence: The group references the two verified subnets

resources.name: Staging RDS PostgreSQL instance
resources.justification: Provide a Single-AZ instance for the lab with explicitly sized class, storage, backup and cost.
expected_evidence: Instance available, encryption, private access and inputs observed; does not prove the business schema

resources.name: Administrative secret managed by RDS
resources.justification: Reuse the RDS managed mechanism for bootstrap and migration; restrict administrative access.
expected_evidence: Reference to the managed secret and restricted authorization; value never attached to evidence

resources.name: Metadata of the application credential secret
resources.justification: Prepare the ARN before the runtime; the initial value is only created in the migration.
expected_evidence: Secret exists, access restricted, without claiming it holds a usable credential

resources.name: Service log group
resources.justification: Make logs available with a defined retention before starting the application.
expected_evidence: Log group, retention and permissions; log arrival will be verified in the runtime

resources.name: GitHub staging environment
resources.justification: Associate the target with the identity context and the applicable controls.
expected_evidence: Environment observed and OIDC claims compatible

resources.name: CI and delivery workflows
resources.justification: Activate two versioned workflows after the merge and verify their identity before the release build.
expected_evidence: Paths and SHA of two workflows, smoke run and permissions observed

resources.name: Candidate OCI image of API and web
resources.justification: Publish one artifact per release that can be promoted by digest.
expected_evidence: Digest, source commit and artifact smoke test

resources.name: Orders schema and tables
resources.justification: Apply the first version of the data structure with a traceable migration.
expected_evidence: Migration version and integrity checks with fixtures

resources.name: Restricted application user in the DB
resources.justification: Separate application and administration credentials.
expected_evidence: Positive/negative permissions and owner of the structures observed

resources.name: Initial version of the restricted credential
resources.justification: Store the credential generated at bootstrap without plaintext in IaC/state or logs.
expected_evidence: Version ID and confirmation of a connection with the restricted role; never record the value

resources.name: Application target group
resources.justification: Integrate Fargate tasks with the existing ingress.
expected_evidence: Target group, port and healthcheck match the contract

resources.name: Staging routing rule
resources.justification: Route only the reserved host/path without replacing other routes.
expected_evidence: Rule and priority observed, including preservation of the existing routes

resources.name: Task definition with digest and secret refs
resources.justification: Pin runtime, artifact, identities, configuration and resources.
expected_evidence: Revision, digest, roles and secret refs checked

resources.name: Fargate service with one staging replica
resources.justification: Keep one replica of the test service; high availability and scaling are not part of the slice.
expected_evidence: Service stabilized, real digest and healthy target

resources.name: Target unavailability and error alarms
resources.justification: Observe two relevant signals with a defined threshold and missing-data handling.
expected_evidence: Two configurations, dimensions and destination observed; notification test only if authorized

resources.name: Orders API capability deployed
resources.justification: Prove the flow in the real runtime, beyond publishing code.
expected_evidence: Results of the flow, denied access and real persistence with synthetic data

resources.name: Web capability deployed in the API artifact
resources.justification: Expose the interface of the first flow using the same artifact and ingress.
expected_evidence: Real navigation and complete orders flow without mocks
